subject: 英語
title: 過去の否定文・疑問文（didn't・Did ～?・Were ～?）（特訓）

questions.prompt:
次の文を否定文にし、さらに「私はギターをひきました。」と続けよう。
I played the piano yesterday.

accepted: I did not play the piano yesterday. I played the guitar.
I didn't play the piano yesterday. I played the guitar.
I didn’t play the piano yesterday. I played the guitar.

questions.explanation: 過去の否定文は didn't ＋動詞のもとの形（play）。

source.number: 特訓（ワークの考え方をもとにしたオリジナル）

questions.ref: 参考：英語ワーク p34（特訓・オリジナル問題）

questions.prompt:
次の文を否定文にし、さらに「私たちはひまでした。」と続けよう。

accepted: We were not busy this morning. We were free.
We weren't busy this morning. We were free.
We weren’t busy this morning. We were free.

questions.explanation: be動詞の過去の否定は were not（weren't）。
